# gtm_container_snippet (Data Source)

Gets the tagging snippet for a Container.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Container snippet's API relative path.

### Read-Only

- `container_config` (String, Sensitive) Server container config param for manually provisioning a tagging server.
- `snippet` (String, Sensitive) Tagging snippet for a Container.
